candidate: (a) custom Canvas renderer: projected triangles via one drawVertices call, painter's depth sort, edge/section lines as quads in the same sort
source: lib/space/renderer.dart (+ camera.dart, model.dart); device harness tool/space/device_bench.dart

apkDeltaBytes.what: Dart code plus the 300,700 B study model; no native code, no new package

host.what: CPU frame build on an M-series Mac (flutter test JIT); not device fps

android.device: A52s SM-A528B, Impeller OpenGL ES fallback, Dart on the merged main thread
android.study20kDrawingChoisyCut: 53.7-57.3 fps in 3 runs (build p90 12.6-15.7 ms); 36.7 fps before the renderer rewrite

measuredOn: host proxy and the reference A52s
lines: yes: hairline feature edges, per-frame silhouettes and heavy section lines at any pixel width, occluded correctly by the depth sort
customShaders: hatching through an ImageShader line-screen texture (row = shade, column = world height); fragment shaders possible but not needed
sectionPlane: yes: axis-aligned plane, triangles clipped on the CPU, inside faces of cut solids drawn as poché, cut edges drawn heavy
depthBuffer: no: painter's algorithm; small slivers can show where large faces interpenetrate (pendentive tips). Mitigation: keep triangles about 2 m or smaller (P09 kit)
vulkan: standard Canvas API: Impeller Vulkan and GLES both supported by the engine; unmeasured on the A52s
offscreen: yes: renders in flutter test, goldens and offscreen PictureRecorder (P17 share stills and frames)
maintenance: Flutter framework API (drawVertices, ImageShader); no third-party package
benchmarkApk: studio/cache/spikes/milion-space-canvas-bench-profile.apk (git-ignored; rebuild with the command in tool/space/device_bench.dart)
runInstructions: reinstall the release app afterwards (same application id)
decision: drawing-style backend for studies up to about 20k triangles; device acceptance (>= 50 fps in every drawing view) open: next experiment is DisableMergedPlatformUIThread (bench APK built), then a background-isolate frame builder if needed
risks: CPU-bound: about 0.3-0.5 us per output triangle on the A52s; 50k triangles cannot reach 50 fps
the CPU governor settles at different clocks run to run (Dart runs on the merged main thread, which the engine does not pin to fast cores); a lighter scene measured slower
painter's sort: slivers where large faces interpenetrate
